QuestInfo.name: [Black Mage] Hidden Identities
QuestInfo.0:
You defeated Hilla in the Labyrinth of Suffering Deep Core.
Orchid has revealed herself. What's her story?
QuestInfo.1:
The Labyrinth Core has vanished, and something new has appeared.
But before that, you need to follow Orchid. There's a lot going on here.
QuestInfo.2:
An image of Guwaru appeared from the broken mask.
You've got more than a few questions for Guwaru.
